comment.author: wegahahegeyha
comment.body_excerpt: Still relevant from our side: we currently work around this gap with a sidecar inline bot for guest media delivery (photos/files to non-added users). An opt-in Guest Mode adapter in the bundled Telegram plugin would let us drop the workaround. Happy to help test.

reasons: On-topic feature feedback describing an existing workaround and the benefit of a Guest Mode adapter.
Offers to help test; contains no solicitation, unrelated promotion, phishing, or abuse.
